title: The Yawpers - Linen for the Orphan

lines.l: There's a girl in the dining room with a vision pinned up to the roof
She hasn't slipped a word to ear since the second one's started to move
Linen, linen for the orphan, linen, linen from the bed
Linen, linen for the orphan, wrap itself up around his head
Mother's gone and the child remains
But the doctor has to balance the books
All pregnant with the body you took
Lean in, lean in for the open
Lean in, lean in from the bed
Lean in, lean in for the open
And the two fuck around his head
Doctor, help this child close his eyes
